Metadata.title: Accordo — New and used musical instruments
Metadata.description: Buy and sell musical instruments, audio, DJ and lighting gear with protected payments and verified feedback.

Home.title: Buy and sell musical instruments safely
Home.subtitle: Free listings for instruments, audio, DJ and lighting. You pay on the platform and the seller is paid only after you confirm you received the item.
Home.protectedText: Your payment is held until you confirm receipt or the inspection window ends.
Home.feedbackText: Only buyers and sellers who completed a real order on the platform can leave feedback.
Home.safetyText: In-app chat with filters, non-clickable external links and identity-verified sellers.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.text: Your personal data will be anonymised and your listings removed. Orders and feedback are kept anonymously to meet legal obligations. This cannot be undone.

responseTime.WITHIN_HOURS: Usually replies within a few hours

Consent.title: We respect your privacy
Consent.text: We use technical cookies required for the site to work. With your consent we would also use anonymous statistics to improve it. You can change your mind at any time from “Cookie preferences” at the bottom of the page.
Consent.necessaryText: Session, security and preferences. Always on.

ConditionHelp.FOR_PARTS: Not working or with major faults

Parcel.M: M — up to 5 kg (interfaces, headphones, soprano sax)
Parcel.L: L — up to 15 kg (cased guitars and basses, synths)

Sell.title: Sell
Sell.draftRestored: We restored the draft you were writing.
Sell.listingTitleHelp: Brand, model and what you are selling. Up to 120 characters.
Sell.descriptionHelp: Plain text, up to 5,000 characters. Describe faults and included accessories; no contact details.
Sell.photosHelp: 1 to 20 JPEG, PNG or WebP photos. The first one is the cover. Photos are resized on your device and stripped of location data.
Sell.dropHere: Drop photos here or choose from your device
Sell.heic: HEIC photos are not supported by this browser: convert them to JPEG in your phone settings and try again.
Sell.unsupported: Unsupported format: use JPEG, PNG or WebP.
Sell.maxPhotos: You can upload up to 20 photos.
Sell.tooLarge: The file is larger than 15 MB.
Sell.protectedPaymentHelp: Coming soon: to get paid with protected payments you will set up a payments account (about 5 minutes).
Sell.shippingIntegratedHelp: Ready-made label and tracking; the buyer pays the cost.
Sell.notShippable: This category cannot be shipped: hand delivery only.
Sell.locationHelp: Only the town and province are shown.
Sell.previewIntro: Check the listing before publishing it.
Sell.pendingReview: Our staff will review your listing before it goes live: we will let you know soon.

Listing.safety1: Pay only with protected payment: outside the platform you are not covered.
Listing.safety2: Never send deposits by bank transfer, top-ups or external links.
Listing.safety3: For hand delivery meet in a public place and try the instrument before paying.
